ropeFrequencyScalingFactor0LoadsTheValue: Ensonga y’okugerageranya emirundi gya RoPE. 0 etikka omuwendo okuva ku muze; 1 ewaliriza tewali kugerageranya.
promptCacheSizeInMibDefault81921: Okusaba obunene bwa cache mu MiB (ekisookerwako: 8192). -1 terina kkomo, 0 ekilemesa.
keepEachConversationSPromptCacheOnDisk: Kuuma buli mboozi prompt cache ku disk kale okuddamu okugiggulawo tekiddamu kusoma mboozi yonna. Ezzibwawo nga model, settings zaayo ne llama.cpp build byonna bikwatagana n'ekyo ekyagitereka.
conversationCacheDiskLimitMib: Ekkomo ku Disiki ya Cache y'emboozi (MiB) .
diskBudgetForSavedConversationCachesDefa: Embalirira ya disiki ey'ebifo eby'emboozi ebiterekeddwa (ekisookerwako: 8192). Ebikulu bisooka kusuulibwa nga bituuse. Emboozi emu empanvu esobola okutwala ebikumi n’ebikumi bya MiB.
minChunkSizeOfMatchingPrefixTokensTo: Min chunk size of matching prefix tokens okuddamu okukozesa okuva mu cache. 0 = eremeddwa.
maximumContextCheckpointsKeptPerSlotWhic: Ebifo ebisinga okukebera embeera ebikuumibwa buli kifo, ebireka embeera ekyusiddwa okuzzibwawo mu kifo ky’okuddamu okulongoosebwa.
checkpointMinimumStep: Omutendera ogusinga obutono mu kifo ekikeberebwa
minimumNumberOfTokensBetweenContextCheck: Omuwendo omutono ogwa tokens wakati w’ebifo ebikeberebwamu embeera.
useFullSizeKvCacheForSlidingWindow: Kozesa KV cache ya sayizi enzijuvu ku bikolwa ebisereba-eddirisa-okufaayo (e.g. Gemma). Kino kisobozesa singa model ng'eyo eddamu okukola ku prompt yonna buli turn mu kifo ky'okuddamu okukozesa cache; kifiiriza okujjukira okusingawo.
useASingleUnifiedKvBufferSharedAcross: Kozesa buffer ya KV emu egabanyizibwa mu bifo byonna. Etereka memory nga oddukanya ebifo ebingi ebikwatagana.
capHowMuchOfTheUnifiedKvCache: Cap mmeka ku unified KV cache one slot eyinza okukozesa, mu tokens. 0 ereka ekifo eky'eddembe okujjuza ekifo kyonna eky'okutereka. Ekola nga cache egatta yokka.
keepTheReasoningOfEveryEarlierAssistantT: Kuuma ensonga za buli muyambi eyasooka okukyuka mu prompt, so si eyo yokka eyasembyeyo. Ekosa models zokka nga chat template yazo egiwagira, era egula obubonero obusaba.
numberOfTokensFromTheInitialPromptTo: Omuwendo gwa tokens okuva mu prompt esooka okukuuma nga context ekyusiddwa. -1 = kuuma byonna.
automaticallyUnloadOtherModelsWhenLoadin: Okutikkula ebika ebirala mu ngeri ey’otoma ng’otikka empya
accessTokensProgrammaticallyAuthenticate: Obubonero bw’okuyingira bukakasa mu pulogulaamu endagamuntu yo eri Hugging Face Hub, okusobozesa enkola okukola ebikolwa ebitongole ebiragiddwa obuwanvu bw’olukusa oluweereddwa.
oneOrMoreFilesExceedTheValue0Mb: Fayiro emu oba eziwera zisukka ekkomo lya {{value0}}MB
areYouSureYouWantToRevokeAccess: Okakasa nti oyagala okusazaamu okuyingira ku kyuma kino? Ekyuma kino kijja kwetaaga okuddamu okukkirizibwa okusobola okukiyingira.
areYouSureYouWantToClearAll: Okakasa nti oyagala okulongoosa ebiwandiiko byonna eby'okuyingira? Ekikolwa kino tekiyinza kuddibwamu.
changingTheAuthenticationModeWillAffectH: Okukyusa mode y'okukakasa kijja kukosa engeri bakasitoma gye bayingira mu instance yo eya Novera. Okakasa nti oyagala kweyongerayo?
theProvidedHuggingFaceTokenIsInvalidPlea: Akabonero ka Hugging Face akaweereddwa si katuufu. Nsaba okebere token yo era ogezeeko nate.
theValidationRequestTimedOutPleaseCheckY: Okusaba okukakasa kwaggwaako. Nsaba okebere omukutu gwo era ogezeeko nate.
aNetworkErrorOccurredWhileValidatingTheT: Ensobi ku mutimbagano yabaddewo nga bakakasa akabonero. Nsaba okebere omukutu gwo ogwa yintaneeti.
downloadProgressEmpty: Enkulaakulana yo ey'okuwanula ejja kulabika wano
importModelReadme: Weekenneenye ebiwandiiko by’ekyokulabirako ku layisinsi yaayo, ennimi eziwagirwa, okujjukira okwetaagisa n’okukozesebwa okugendereddwa nga tonnawanula.
settingsLanguageHelp: Enkyukakyuka mu lulimi zikola ku nkolagana. Eby’okuddamu eby’ekyokulabirako bisinziira ku biragiro byo n’ennimi eziwagirwa ekyokulabirako ekirondeddwa.
apiFallbackHint: Ekisumuluzo ekikulu kiri #1. Novera eddamu okugezaako ekisumuluzo ekiddako oluvannyuma lw'okuddamu 401, 403 oba 429.
unexpectedErrorHelp: Waliwo ekyatambula obubi. Ddamu omuko guno oba tuukirira abayambi singa ekizibu kisigalawo.
huggingFaceTokenValid: Akabonero ko aka Hugging Face kakola.
keyRateLimited: Omuwendo gukoma oba guvudde mu bbanja (429)
chatTemplateOptions: Enkola z'okulonda mu nkola y'okukubaganya ebirowoozo
dependencySomeCoreBackendFilesAreMissing: Fayiro ezimu eza core backend zibula oba zoonoonese — kino kitera okutegeeza nti okuwanula kwasalibwako oba archive yaggyibwamu kitundu kyokka. Ssaawo backend era oddemu okugiwanula okuva mu nteekateeka za Novera.
dependencyInstallNcclFromTheNvidiaDevelo: Teeka NCCL okuva ku mukutu gwa NVIDIA Developer. NCCL ekozesebwa mu mpuliziganya ez'omuggundu eza GPU eziwera.
dependencyInstallNcclViaTheNvidiaPackage: Teeka NCCL ng'oyita mu tterekero ly'ebipapula bya NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt ssaako libnccl2 libnccl-dev. Laba ekitabo ekikwata ku kuteeka NVIDIA NCCL ku distro yo.
dependencyInstallCudnnFromTheNvidiaDevel: Teeka cuDNN okuva ku mukutu gwa NVIDIA Developer era oteeke DLLs ku mabbali g’enkola oba mu System32.
dependencyInstallCudnnViaTheNvidiaPackag: Teeka cuDNN ng'oyita mu tterekero ly'ebipapula bya NVIDIA oba wanula tarball n'okukoppa libs ku /usr/local/cuda/lib64.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanRuntimeFromLun: Teeka Vulkan Runtime okuva ku LunarG. Ddereeva wo wa GPU ayinza okugiyingizaamu dda — sooka olongoose ddereeva wo wa GPU.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Teeka ekintu ekitikkira Vulkan: ku Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt teeka libvulkan1. Ku Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-omutikkira. Ku RHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf ssaako vulkan-loader.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkitFromNvidi: Teeka CUDA Toolkit okuva mu NVIDIA. Mu kiseera ky'okussaako, londa ebitundu bya "CUDA".
Teeka CUDA Toolkit okuva mu NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt teeka cuda-ebikozesebwa-12. Ku RHEL/Fedora: kozesa repo ya NVIDIA.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit11FromNvi: Teeka ekitabo ky'ebikozesebwa ekya CUDA 11 okuva mu NVIDIA. Mu kiseera ky'okussaako, londa ebitundu bya "CUDA".
Teeka ekitabo ky'ebikozesebwa ekya CUDA 11 okuva mu NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt teeka cuda-ebikozesebwa-11. Ku RHEL/Fedora: kozesa repo ya NVIDIA.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit12FromNvi: Teeka ekitabo ky'ebikozesebwa ekya CUDA 12 okuva mu NVIDIA. Mu kiseera ky'okussaako, londa ebitundu bya "CUDA".
Teeka ekitabo ky'ebikozesebwa ekya CUDA 12 okuva mu NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt teeka cuda-ebikozesebwa-12. Ku RHEL/Fedora: kozesa repo ya NVIDIA.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit13FromNvi: Teeka ekitabo ky'ebikozesebwa ekya CUDA 13 okuva mu NVIDIA. Mu kiseera ky'okussaako, londa ebitundu bya "CUDA".
Teeka ekitabo ky'ebikozesebwa ekya CUDA 13 okuva mu NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt teeka cuda-ebikozesebwa-13. Ku RHEL/Fedora: kozesa repo ya NVIDIA.
generationCountHint: Londa ebifaananyi, ennyimba oba vidiyo mmeka z’olina okukola (1–10). Buli kintu kikolebwa mu mutendera. Stop esazaamu emirimu egisigadde.
